t: You're looking at the statue of Sir John Fox Burgoyne, on the western side of Waterloo Place. It's Grade II listed and was unveiled in 1877. The sculptor was Joseph Edgar Boehm, who also made the Duke of Wellington statue at Hyde Park Corner. Burgoyne was a field marshal who served under Wellington in the Peninsular War, and later advised Lord Raglan during the Crimean War, recommending the siege of Sevastopol from the south side. It is one of several statues on this street.
